channel.title: Azure HorizonDB on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Azure HorizonDB on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Geo-redundant backup and restore for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Geo-redundant backup and restore is now generally available for Azure HorizonDB. It lets you store backups in a geo-redundant way and restore a HorizonDB deployment in another Azure region when needed.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Generally Available: Customize backup retention from 1 to 35 days in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB backup retention can now be configured from 1 to 35 days. This lets deployments match retention settings to application and data protection requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: AI model management in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now offers limited preview support for AI model management, letting users provision fully managed models directly in the database. The preview covers embeddings, semantic ranking, and generation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Generally Available: Private endpoint support for Azure HorizonDB clusters
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB clusters now support private connectivity through Azure Private Link with a private IP from your virtual network. Private DNS integration simplifies setup, and public access can be disabled for tighter network control.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Build Knowledge Graphs with AI pipeline in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now offers a public preview of an AI pipeline that builds knowledge graphs from PostgreSQL data. The feature uses AI to extract entities, relationships, and properties from source data and construct a queryable graph.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Encryption at rest with customer-managed keys in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports customer-managed keys (CMK) for encryption at rest in public preview. The service previously used only service-managed keys (SMK) by default.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Oracle databases to Azure HorizonDB using Azure Database Migration Service
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports migrating Oracle databases to Azure HorizonDB in public preview. The migration flow covers source and target connection setup, schema selection, data transfer, and progress tracking in one experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB now integrates with Azure Advisor
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now generally available with Azure Advisor integration. Advisor analyzes HorizonDB resources and provides personalized recommendations to improve reliability and performance.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB Auditing
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports database auditing through the pgAudit extension. Audit logs can capture selected PostgreSQL activities such as data access, modifications, role changes, and DDL operations, and can be sent to Azure Monitor Log Analytics.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB Generic Log Analytics Integration
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports Azure Monitor diagnostic settings integration to send database logs and diagnostic data to Azure Log Analytics. This enables centralized querying, analysis, and troubleshooting of database activity.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB Monitoring via Alerts
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports Azure Monitor alerts in general availability. You can create alert rules on HorizonDB metrics, set thresholds, and receive notifications when conditions are met.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB System Managed Maintenance Window
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports system-managed maintenance for planned service upgrades. Azure automatically handles cluster upgrades without requiring customers to configure or manage a maintenance schedule.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Policy support for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure Policy support for Azure HorizonDB is now available in preview. A new built-in policy can automatically deploy diagnostic settings to help apply governance and observability standards across HorizonDB deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Improved Apache AGE graph query and ingestion performance on Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now includes generally available Apache AGE performance improvements for graph querying and knowledge graph ingestion. The update speeds up eligible read queries through better query planning and graph joins, and improves duplicate detection and memory handling during graph build operations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Entra authentication for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Microsoft Entra authentication is now generally available for Azure HorizonDB. It lets you use identity-based database authentication and centrally manage access instead of relying on local credentials.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: User-assigned managed identity for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
User-assigned managed identity (UMI) support is now generally available for Azure HorizonDB. It lets you assign and centrally manage Azure identities for HorizonDB clusters, reducing the need to manage credentials directly.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Azure Database for PostgreSQL to Azure HorizonDB with Azure Database Migration Service (DMS)
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service (DMS) now supports migrating existing Azure Database for PostgreSQL workloads to Azure HorizonDB in public preview. The update extends DMS V2 architecture with HorizonDB as a migration target.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate PostgreSQL servers to Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports public preview migrations of supported PostgreSQL workloads to Azure HorizonDB. The migration experience is guided and available in the Azure portal.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure HorizonDB supports PostgreSQL 18
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now in public preview with PostgreSQL 18 support. The service is a fully managed, PostgreSQL-compatible cloud-native database for scalable, high-performance workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates
